Absent: Supervisor Feinstein — 1 . Ordering the improvement of Bishop Street between Ankeny Street and Harkness Avenue…

Gallagher is hereby granted the following extensions of time to complete street work, viz.: Ninety days, from and after September 20, 1920 within which to complete the improvement of Cowden street between Wilde avenue and Ankenny street.

Of 1918 of said City and County of San Francisco, does hereby determine and declare that the assessment to be imposed for the said contemplated improvements, respectively, may be paid in ten installments…
